title: Cross-deployment escalation matrix and hotfix runbook for model regressions
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: define a concise, actionable escalation matrix and hotfix runbook that applies to model rollout regressions across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Scope: detection thresholds, decision gates for rollback vs patch, KV-cache reconciliation, tenant-scoped containment, customer comms templates, and post-incident validation. This ticket captures runbook text, playbook checklists, and links to automation PRs so oncall and SRE can execute predictable remediations without ad-hoc coordination overhead.
acceptance_criteria: A single triage checklist that an oncall engineer can execute within 30 minutes and document decisions
Clear decision matrix that maps metric signatures to actions (flow: degrade -> quarantine variant -> rollback -> hotpatch)
Automated preflight scripts for safe rollback exist in GitHub and are referenced in the runbook
Customer-facing comm templates for SRE/CSM are included and reviewed by PM
A dry-run of the runbook is scheduled and recorded with SRE, PM, and CSM participants
triage_matrix: Metric signature: per-tenant latency spike + increase in token truncation errors -> Action: isolate slice, switch to pinned variant, open incident channel
Metric signature: high error rate (>5% 5m) on hosted only -> Action: immediate weighted rollback to previous model in hosted region, begin KV cache reconciliation
Metric signature: uniform degradation across Dedicated pools -> Action: confirm scheduler/kernel selection mismatch, escalate to runtime oncall, consider temporary capacity scale-out
Metric signature: Private (customer-managed network) anomaly reported by customer -> Action: involve CSM, request logs and bundle, offer guided rollback steps and safe patch instructions
runbook_steps: 1) Confirm impact window and collect run-level artifacts: model version, variant id, region, tenant slice, recent inference logs, KV-cache age snapshots
2) Evaluate Canary thresholds: if canary fails with >30% quality regression or >3x latency increase over baseline, mark canary failed
3) Decision gate: If customer-facing error or regulatory data concern, prioritize rollback over patch

4) If rollback chosen: trigger automated rollback job (GH Action) for Hosted; for Dedicated trigger orchestration job with pool draining; for Private provide signed rollback bundle and ops instructions to customer
5) After rollback: run KV-cache reconciliation script to avoid stale prefix artifacts (commands and checksum verification included below), and purge affected caches per-tenant where possible
6) Validate post-rollout metrics for 30m and escalate if anomalies persist
7) Document timeline, notify CS/PM, schedule postmortem within 72 hours
kv_cache_reconciliation_notes: Key observation from last incidents: rolling back model binary without reconciling KV caches results in rare hallucination regressions. Reconciliation steps: 1) snapshot current KV cache metadata, 2) flush per-tenant prefixes older than rollback time, 3) resync hot prefixes from pinned variant. Scripts are in GH PR #2786. For Dedicated, coordinate with node owners to prevent cache thrash. For Private, provide a targeted cache-flush script and include checksum tool for customer validation.
communication_templates: Initial customer acknowledgement: 'We’ve opened an incident on your behalf and are investigating. We will provide a follow-up within 30 minutes with mitigation steps.'
Post-rollout update: 'We rolled back to model vX.Y and flushed KV cache for your tenant slice. Please validate quality and report any residual issues.'
Root-cause follow-up: 'Root cause analysis scheduled. We will share mitigation timelines and permanent fixes within 5 business days.'

rollback_playback: Hosted: trigger GH Action 'rollback-hosted' with model_id and target_version; monitor canary until 2 consecutive 5m windows are healthy. Dedicated: mark pool read-only, drain in-flight, apply model binary rollback, restart runtime worker processes with zero-downtime handoff. Private: provide signed rollback bundle and runbook; offer remote assist if customer consents. Ensure KV cache reconciliation run after binary change and before marking pool healthy.
mitigation_summary: Work done during last regression: automated canary quarantine implemented (routes 10% traffic away), emergency rollback job executed for hosted in 14 minutes, KV reconciliation script applied to 12 high-traffic tenants, and customer comms sent within 25 minutes. Runtime patch to kernel-selection heuristic drafted and targeted for runtime-1.22.
